claim.task: for every common manifest M and task run objects R_task_s0,R_task_s1, P_task(M,R_task_s0,R_task_s1) implies C_task(M,R_task_s0,R_task_s1)
claim.full: for every common manifest M and full run objects R_full_s0,R_full_s1, P_full(M,R_full_s0,R_full_s1) implies C_full(M,R_full_s0,R_full_s1)
claim.coupling: neither implication has the other role's run objects or cell antecedents

unconditional_claims.factorization: for total pi:S->Q=image(pi), tau:S->Y, a unique g:Q->Y with tau=g composed_with pi exists iff ker(pi) subseteq ker(tau)
unconditional_claims.witness: the exact task singleton cannot reconstruct both distinct J(P) targets

manifest_model.identity: manifest_payload_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON after removing only that field
common_scope: installed distribution versions, roots, module origins and full tree hashes
eleven load-bearing source paths and hashes
site/import context and non-executable pth inventory
manifest_model.reason: M0 records absent LangGraph, LangChain-core, dependency lock and source audit

canonicalization.domain: JSON objects and arrays whose leaves are integers, strings, booleans, or null

outer_arguments.second: absolute path of the authenticated manifest M

closed_fixture.output: one canonical record with cell, manifest_id, observed_hex, run_id, status; a role launch emits exactly its two child records

guard_protocol.pre_import: load and authenticate manifest payload, acquired status, artifacts, interpreter, stdlib, exact child environment, dependency lock, packages, all load-bearing files, source-audit report and import context before importing LangGraph
guard_protocol.compile: import LangGraph locally and compile exactly one graph
guard_protocol.final_atomic_guard: immediately after compile and before invoke, verify_all_guards reauthenticates the entire common manifest bundle and checks exact compiled channels, mapper, node policies and retained services
guard_protocol.invoke: exactly one graph.invoke occurs only after the final guard returns
guard_protocol.failure: any require failure raises OMST_RUNTIME_GUARD_FAILED before correspondence observation

source_basis_langchain_core.future_rule: an acquired M binds exact version, distribution tree, origins and path hashes; its separately authenticated source audit must verify callback/config no-pre-capture-mutation behavior

source_lemmas.L_compile: state.py registers exact TypedDict schemas, LastValue fields, selected channels, None mapper, START PregelNode and None services
source_lemmas.L_start: _io.map_input writes the whole literal dict to START; the START task receives it; state.py _get_updates emits field writes and capture trigger; apply_writes makes selected LastValue fields available
source_lemmas.L_fresh: _loop.py substitutes _checkpoint.empty_checkpoint, whose values, versions and seen maps are empty; channels_from_checkpoint constructs fresh channels
source_lemmas.L_prepare: _loop.tick calls _algo.prepare_next_tasks; a fresh input_cache feeds _proc_input, which reads selected channels with no mapper into PregelExecutableTask.input
source_lemmas.L_deliver: _retry invokes task.proc with task.input; PregelNode.node constructs RunnableSeq(bound,writers); LangGraph RunnableSeq sends unchanged initial input to the first bound RunnableCallable; acquired LangChain-core callback/config sources satisfy P5; capture serializes before any write
source_lemmas.trace: literal dict -> START whole dict -> _get_updates fields plus trigger -> selected LastValue availability -> task.input -> PregelNode RunnableSeq -> bound RunnableCallable -> capture

P_common_M: M has a valid canonical payload hash and acquired status
artifact/interpreter/stdlib/lock/package/source/audit/import/config identities authenticate exactly before import and again in the final guard
L_compile,L_start,L_fresh,L_prepare,L_deliver and P5 were independently verified by the exact authenticated source-audit report
P_cell_M_R: R names exactly one cell and its bound run_id under M
the role launcher creates one fresh process and temporary directory with the exact child environment
the cell compiles one graph, passes the single final post-compile guard bundle and invokes once
observed_hex derives only from capture's callable-entry mapping before any write

conditional_consequences.received: received(cell,M,R_cell) is the canonical UTF-8 mapping serialized at capture callable entry in that run object
conditional_consequences.C_full: received(full_s0,M,R_full_s0) and received(full_s1,M,R_full_s1) differ exactly at provenance_record.agent_id

gates.phase2: review theorem, witness and the two universal role-specific conditional implications only; P_common(M0) is false
gates.acquisition: separate authorization is required to install packages and create an acquired manifest plus source-audit report
gates.phase3_task: a task launch is independently admissible when P_common and exactly its two P_cell antecedents hold
gates.phase3_full: a full launch is independently admissible when P_common and exactly its two P_cell antecedents hold
gates.cell_failure: any preauthentication or final-guard failure aborts before observation and leaves only that role's implication unapplied

scope.label: record-reconstruction/schema-sufficiency control relative to tau
not_claimed: general security failure or framework vulnerability
new theorem or standalone top-tier contribution

authorization_boundary: no framework download, installation, import or execution
no live target or operational attack
